question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Delay
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hasten**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Delay"** means to make someone or something late or slow. (विलंब)
 
 
• **Example: **The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
 
 
 
• **"Hasten"** refers to moving or acting quickly; to speed up. (शीघ्र करना)
 
 
• **Example: **They hastened to finish the project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Delay'** is **'Hasten'**.
